title: Fix Vertical Misalignment in Sketchpad Detail Panel Property Rows
description: Fixed vertical misalignment of stepper, slider, and input controls in the detail panel property rows. All of these elements should be on the exact same vertical line.
summary: Fixed vertical misalignment of stepper, slider, and input controls in the detail panel property rows by adding CSS overrides to rightSidePanelElementSizingClassName: (1) explicit items-center on property-row to guarantee vertical centering of the grid, (2) h-[22px] on property-control to lock all control containers to a uniform 22px height ensuring stepper, slider, and input controls share the same vertical line, (3) h-auto override for property-control containing textarea to preserve textarea expandability, (4) explicit h-[22px] on slider-row for consistency.
